SELECT 'inv_vend_orphan' k, count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_jrnl_orphan', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" j WHERE j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_inv_orphan', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'line_hdr_orphan', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" j WHERE j."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'line_acct_orphan', count(*) FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_prd_orphan', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" j WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=j."PRD_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'hdr_no_lines', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" j WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=j."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'unbalanced_jrnl', count(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'post_dt_outside_prd', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" j JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE j."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'post_after_close', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" j JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE j."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_shared_by_invs', count(*) FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_inv_pay_mismatch', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='P' AND i."INV_AMT" <> coalesce((SELECT sum("PAY_AMT") FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID"),0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'open_with_pay', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_pay_inv', count(*) FROM (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_vendinv', count(*) FROM (SELECT "VEND_CD","INV_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_in_other_prd', count(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" j USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE j."SRC_CD"<>'AP'
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_before_inv', count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_in_closed_period_unposted_dt', count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" j JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."STAT_CD"='O'

SELECT j."SRC_CD", j."MEMO" LIKE 'Payment%' pay, j."MEMO" LIKE 'Credit%' cm, j."MEMO" LIKE 'Invoice%' inv, l."ACCT_CD", count(*), sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" j USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

SELECT "JRNL_NO","PRD_ID","POST_DT","POST_FLG","REF_JRNL_NO","SRC_CD","SRC_REF","MEMO" FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "JRNL_NO" IN (1000,1001,2323,2473,2475) OR "MEMO" !~ '^(Invoice|Payment|Manual accrual)' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 40
